cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：任命；约定
cards.example_en: The club will appoint a new captain after the vote.
cards.example_zh: 投票结束之后，俱乐部将任命一位新队长。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：感激；欣赏
cards.example_en: I really appreciate your help with my science project.
cards.example_zh: 我非常感激你帮我做科学项目。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：赞同；批准
cards.example_en: Parents must approve the camp form before Thursday.
cards.example_zh: 家长必须在周四之前批准这份夏令营表格。

cards.example_en: Brothers often argue about who sits by the window.
cards.example_zh: 兄弟俩经常争论谁坐在窗户旁边。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：出现；起来
cards.example_en: Problems arise when nobody locks the bicycle shed.
cards.example_zh: 要是没人锁自行车棚，问题就会出现。

cards.example_en: Let's arrange a time to meet.
cards.example_zh: 让我们安排一个见面的时间。

cards.example_en: New classmates and I associate during the lunch break.
cards.example_zh: 午休的时候，我和新同学一起交往。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：假定；认为
cards.example_en: I assume you have read the report.
cards.example_zh: 我猜你已经看过报告了。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：洗澡；浴缸
cards.example_en: I take a hot bath after football practice.
cards.example_zh: 足球训练后我会洗个热水澡。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：打；打败
cards.example_en: Our team can beat the visitors if we pass better.
cards.example_zh: 如果我们传球更好，就能打败客队。

cards.example_en: Leaves become red and gold on the hills in autumn.
cards.example_zh: 秋天，山上的叶子会变成红色和金色。

cards.example_en: Lessons begin when the bell rings in the main hall.
cards.example_zh: 主楼大厅的铃一响，课就开始了。

cards.example_en: I can't believe it's already Friday.
cards.example_zh: 真不敢相信它已经到了。

cards.example_en: Don't break the glass when you wash the dishes.
cards.example_zh: 洗碗时别把玻璃杯打破。

cards.example_en: Please bring your lunch to the picnic by the lake.
cards.example_zh: 去湖边野餐时，请带上你的午餐。
